analysis.narrativeEn:

· Current price ($1.35) vs SMA5 ($1.36)/SMA20 ($1.39)/SMA50 ($1.22): below short-term, above mid-term, above long-term
· Above SMA100 ($1.17)/SMA200 ($1.27): maintaining mid-to-long term trend strength
· 52-week position (16.9%) + current price level near historical lows
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (53.4→51.9) + neutral assessment + weakening momentum
· MACD histogram trajectory (-0.0180→-0.0180) + holding steady assessment + no trend reversal signal
· Bollinger Band current price position (mid-band $1.39) + 9.85% band width at normal levels
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($1.35) + basis (current price, similar to Pivot S2)
· Swing resistance ($1.39) + potential for breaking above SMA20 upon breach
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (mixed Higher Low/Lower High) + sideways trend interpretation
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.41x) + reduced confidence in price movement
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase) + conditions for entry: RSI recovery above 50 with accompanying volume increase confirmation
